ratings_why.fun: The Long Wait gives a real spike turn to plan for, and the Carnival grows every turn; the Hive's early turns cost a unit and win nothing.
ratings_why.distinct: Gold flow as the resource, saved coins paying twice, and Tettix growing in hand play unlike today's tribes, though Spree echoes Battlegrounds' gold-spent cards.

verdict_why: No unit says which town it's in, and several cards read towns; that needs fixing before the design can be judged settled.

points.text: No unit is tagged Hive, Carnival or Road, yet Tymbal Drummer, Olive-Press Hand, Signora Afide, Maestro Tettix and Mother Melissa all read towns. Add the town to every unit.
Ottavia's "freeze it": does it freeze only that unit or the whole shop? The Long Wait plan depends on which.
The Hive has no fighter from Tier 2 to Tier 4, so saving turns just lose fights. The designer's barbed Guard Bee at Tier 2 or 3 would give winter a body.
Mother Melissa with Old Messor and Clemenza lays several copies a turn and is capped only by the 4-card hand; worth a test, and the hand cap may be the right natural limit.
Penniless Tenor could read "1 gold or less" so an odd leftover coin doesn't switch it off.

standouts.why: A nymph that grows in hand while you save, then leads the band on the summer turn: the tribe's arc in one card.
Lord Fennimore turns a Hive body into a Spree pump that grows each lap, an easy and fun loop to read.
Comptroller Gravelle makes a held bank fight, giving the Hive its late payoff and an answer to Shields and tokens.

weakest.why: Nurse Bee needs the back row, two units in front and saved gold for a small buff; it rarely earns its slot.
Olive-Press Hand feeds each town from the other at random, which on most boards means half its text does nothing.
Busker is a vanilla body on saving turns and small on spending ones.

flags.note: With Madame Cigale each Fennimore lap is a Spree and he grows +2/+2 with no cap; bounded by gold, but steep.
Melissa plus Messor plus Clemenza could chain triples and golden Discovers every turn.
Clemenza with Messor makes every coin pay both towns, doubled; a strong capstone, check it against the Tier 6 ceiling.
Several Tettix Masks plus Penniless Tenor grow steeply past the Tier 6 ceiling, as the designer warns.
Unclear whether "freeze it" freezes one unit or the whole shop.
Can't tell which units are Carnival, so Tymbal Drummer's reach can't be read.
